title: EvOrderBench: When do sampled frames establish event order?

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EvOrderBench, a real-video benchmark of 579 event families.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each family fixes an episode and a question and varies only the frames: of two four-frame inputs, only one establishes the order, and two six-frame inputs extend the other one with either the frames that resolve the order or frames that do not.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across sixteen open-weight configurations and three closed-source references, the best open models order nearly as accurately as the references when the frames establish the order, but withhold correctly on at most 83% of the inputs where they do not, against at least 90% for every reference; forced-choice accuracy cannot reveal this gap.
